purpose: Causally distinguish shared GL2/GDDR service from CU-local IU4/LDS/barrier service for the retained N16/K16 A8Q4G64 P2048 kernel by reducing available CUs while measuring matched IU4 and greater-than-L2 stream controls.

hardware.wgp_pairing: Each mask is a contiguous even-CU range, so no WGP is split. HIP may report 32 scheduler units; that does not change the architectural 64-CU mask contract.

controls: packed Q4-code/FP16-scale stream larger than L2

classification.production_metric: 176-call selected-region Q4 summed-duration throughput relative to full64
classification.cu_local: Both masked production throughput ratios match the measured IU4 ratios within 10% and do not also match the stream ratios.
classification.shared_memory: Both masked production throughput ratios match the measured greater-than-L2 stream ratios within 10% and do not also match the IU4 ratios.
classification.mixed_or_inconclusive: Any valid response matching both curves or neither curve. This result admits no architecture change by itself.
classification.invalid: Any missing arm, wrong workload/kernel inventory, non-auto power evidence, failed artifact/input identity, insufficient stream working set, or IU4 response not within 10% of the nominal half/quarter mask response.

limitations: The trace duration is comparative attribution, not unprofiled production timing.
The stream control is a measured shared-memory curve, not a physical byte counter for the production kernel.
A mixed/inconclusive result does not justify another Q4 kernel candidate.

power.mutation: none; the package never writes the power-profile node and requires no sudo
